title: Adaptive Capillary Skin (ACS): Open Falsifiable Design of a Biomimetic Fluidic Material Integrating Water Transport, Hygromorphic Regulation, Evaporative Cooling, Electrokinetic Self-Sensing, and Damage-Triggered Hydraulic Isolation
description: Open computational design disclosure and falsification protocol for Adaptive Capillary Skin (ACS). The package contains no physical experimental measurements; all reported numerical results are virtual predictions intended to define build specifications and preregistered rejection criteria.
